geometry_policy: Use the existing open arena setup and separately verified existing static near-wall placements. The targeted cycle ends after defensive retreat and wait_300; actual visibility, collision and per-action physical guards remain mandatory.
policy: Every teacher label starts at an exact fresh periodic numerical observation, passes a declared physical rule, and is approved only after its real completed execution and independent per-action outcome proof. Original stage 6 records remain immutable.

rules.approach: A visible opponent is outside melee range; move into native weapon range.
rules.turn_to_target: A visible opponent is more than five degrees off the body's attack axis; reduce the angle into native focus.
rules.strafe_left: At safe distance, select a clear left lateral ray; require real lateral displacement without HP loss.
rules.strafe_right: At safe distance, select a clear right lateral ray; require real lateral displacement without HP loss.
rules.jump_back: React to a newly observed incoming melee attack after a completed block; require increased separation, real displacement and no HP loss or actual melee damage. Each mapped opponent hit attempt must be an explicit range/focus miss or an upstream applied delivery linked one-to-one to a same-time mapped native melee jumped_back defense result with a strictly later trace sequence.
rules.attack_front: A visible idle opponent is in clear, focused native weapon range; require an actual applied hit and target HP loss.
rules.attack_left: The most recent completed strike was front; allow genuinely completed approach/turn corrections between strikes, require clear focused range and actual damage.
rules.attack_right: The most recent completed strike was left; allow genuinely completed approach/turn corrections between strikes, require clear focused range and actual damage.
rules.block: React to a visible incoming melee attack in native weapon range; require a native blocked hit without HP loss.
rules.wait_200: Briefly assess after completed lateral repositioning at safe distance with no observed attack; require the actual 200 ms wait, stationary position and unchanged HP.
rules.wait_300: Hold safe separation after a completed defensive retreat with no observed attack; the opponent may perform real retreat commands first without changing primary history. Require the actual 300 ms wait, stationary position and unchanged HP.

limitations: This is an independent deterministic scripted teacher, not a native AI label or a guarantee of optimal tactics.
A failed guard or physical proof creates no expert label and cannot satisfy coverage.

New demonstrations target eight deficient classes; existing immutable native strafe_left, strafe_right and wait_200 labels supply their complement. The combined BC dataset must still cover all eleven actions with at least twenty usable training labels each.
Every cycle ends as a time-limit truncation after completed demonstrations; it is not a duel victory. Extra corrective approaches/turns are real separately proved decisions, not duplicated labels.
Near-wall evidence comes from existing static collision geometry, numerical rays and native capsule probes, with no runtime teleport or collision fixture.
